messages.subject: pcount: Error in optim
parts:
Hello unmarked group,

I am using the pcount model-fitting function and getting the following
error:

Error in optim(starts, nll, method = method, hessian = se, control =
control) : initial value in 'vmmin' is not finite.

My code is:

> WFframe <- unmarkedFramePCount(
+ y = WF[,c("WFF", "WFV")],
+ siteCovs = as.data.frame(WF)
+ )
>
> (VegArea <- pcount(~Veg + Area ~Veg + Area + Orsez + Orsez2, WFframe, starts=c(-1,0,0,-1,0,0,0,0)))
Error in optim(starts, nll, method = method, hessian = se, control =
control) :
initial value in 'vmmin' is not finiteCan someone help me
troubleshoot this error?

With Thanks,

David Pavlacky

messages.author: df74d6fccec2ff7e
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] pcount: Error in optim
parts:
Hi David,

Have you standardized your covariates? If not, you should be able to do:

siteCovs(WFframe) <- scale(siteCovs(WFframe))

Also, have you tried fitting simpler models and using the estimates as
starting values? If those suggestions don't work, could you send the
results of

summary(WFframe)

Thanks,
Richard
